title: Scaffold React Vite webapp
description: Initialize Vite React TypeScript project in workspace/simple-notes-webapp.
steps: Initialize Vite React TS app in workspace/simple-notes-webapp using npm create vite@latest or manual config
Configure vite.config.ts with dev server proxy (/api -> http://localhost:3001)
Set up basic CSS styles (index.css / App.css) for simple clean UI
Define TypeScript interface Note in src/types.ts (id, title, content, created_at, updated_at)
Run npm build to verify compiles
